sources.observed_facts: Default standalone mode; cluster requires redis backend and a nonempty address; Redis settings use duration parsing and documented defaults.
Startup resolves the database dialect before coordination; creates and pings one provider, then wires cluster, cachecoord, auth, session, and plugin services before route/runtime startup.
One topology interface owns enabled mode, primary state and node ID; election is constructed internally only for cluster mode with a lock provider.
Standalone Start/Stop bypass election and IsPrimary returns true; cluster delegates to election state.
Plugin node projection synchronization and reads return early outside cluster mode.
Shared lifecycle effects use standalone-or-primary topology checks.
